text:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] releasebot detected secret rotation for svc=payments-svc (staging) during canary — pods restarted (3/10). Block reason: secretHash mismatch. logs: /var/log/deploy/rel-18123
Alex: seeing this now. is it safe to continue the canary?
Maria: quick skim — app crashes on startup after env var change. KMS rewrap likely changed ciphertext format.
Jia: can we do a staged evacuation (keep old secret, drain new pods, then flip)? avoids full rollback.
ops_oncall: reminder — change window is 02:00-03:00 UTC. anything outside gets blocked by deploy-bot; prefer to run during window.
Release Manager: options:
- A) rollback chart to previous version (fast, but loses any hotfixes in current chart)
- B) pin secret name in values and run staged evacuation during window (targeted, minimal churn)
thoughts?
Alex: prefer B (pin+evac). less blast radius and release notes easier.
Maria: agree. we should pin old secret and annotate release as staged-evac so deploy-bot doesn't auto-block.
Jia: proposed values override to pin and annotation to allow staged evac:
```yaml
# values-override.yaml
payments:
  secretName: payments-secret-v1  # pin to previous stable secret
  allowEvacuation: true
```
and add release annotation:
```
metadata:
  annotations:
    deploy.redwood/evac-stage: staged
```
ops_oncall: deploy-bot will still block unless that annotation is present — confirmed.
deploy-bot: blocking rule: missing `deploy.redwood/evac-stage`. to allow staged evac, include `metadata.annotations['deploy.redwood/evac-stage']='staged'` on release. Once annotation present, bot allows canary continuation with evacuation tag.
Maria: sequence I'd run in window:
1) apply values override via helm (reuse-values):
   `helm upgrade payments ./charts/payments --namespace staging --reuse-values -f values-override.yaml`
2) annotate deployments to trigger controlled rollout:
   `kubectl annotate deploy payments-frontend deploy.redwood/evac-stage=staged -n staging`
3) cordon/drain a subset or use rolling update:
   `kubectl rollout restart deploy/payments-frontend -n staging`
Jia: add a preflight health-check script to run after each batch. If >5% errors, abort and rollback.
Alex: will monitor logs/metrics. I can abort canary quickly if error spike.
Release Manager: release notes snippet (to post after decision):
- Staging: pinned payments secret to `payments-secret-v1` during KMS rotation; enabled staged-evac annotation so canary proceeds with minimal disruption. Monitor 5% error threshold. Follow-up: rotate back to `payments-secret-v2` after KMS rewrap completes.
ops_oncall: I'll set pager for the window and add the snippet to the release notes draft. tagging @oncall
Maria: pushing values-override and adding release annotation now. will post helm command output here.
Maria: (helm) `upgrade complete — 3/3 deployed, 0 pending`
Alex: rolling check — logs look steady so far. no new 5xx in last 2m.
ops_oncall: good, keep an eye on latency too. set alerts to trigger at 2x baseline.
Jia: adding the preflight script to CI so we can automate batch checks for future rotations.
Release Manager: final call: proceed with staged evacuation during 02:00-03:00 UTC window. Maria, Alex -- confirm you'll be on-call for rollback.
Alex: on-call and watching. :thumbsup:
Maria: on it. will revert annotation and values if we exceed threshold.
deploy-bot: note: will auto-unblock canary once `deploy.redwood/evac-stage=staged` annotation is detected on the release. Good luck.
Release Manager: I'll post final release note and close the thread after window. thanks team.
